description: Ultimate tier — strongest picks under the cost red line on OpenCode Zen: deepseek-v4-flash anchors flash exploration, gemini-3.8-flash drives standard orchestration, gpt-6-sol powers pro-level coding at $2/$10 (gpt-5.6-sol repriced to $4/$20 and breaches the cap), grok-4.7 delivers flagship review reasoning at $1.4/$4.2 (newer and cheaper than grok-4.6), and claude-sonnet-5 ($2/$10, superseding sonnet-4-6) enables vision attachments.
